about_the_game:
The Adventure of Pixi: The 3 Stones is an adventure game made solely by Czar, with an electrifying retro-inspired soundtrack made by Pouale! Originally a game made in their teen years in 2011, it is now a fully remade game made with care after more than a decade of experience! With a completely new story and new soundtrack!



An adventure of epic proportions, spanning 1 fully opened map, 2 worlds, and (more than) 3 colors!



Living in peace in a world of black, white and all the shades in between, the Pixel race never was interested in learning their origins, except a single one that everyone would call Old Man.



Obsessed with history ever since he was a child, he spent his whole life searching for those things called colors.
Until one day, he found a magical artefact containing the information he sought all his life: How to restore colors to the world.
Suffering of old age and joint pain, he decided to give this quest of a lifetime to his fashion-obsessed, wig-wearer, younger assistant: Pixi.



As you control Pixi, you get to fully explore the whole black and white world of Pixeleuh, full of humoristic characters and actions, containing an handful of hidden items, and also a few dungeons, where the titular stones are hiding!
You can also change your hairstyle when you feel like it by going into Pixi's wardrobe; other than being cosmetics it changes some NPCs dialogs! Maybe even an obtainable wig is necessary to progress in a dungeon?



... But once the colors are restored, will that really be the end of her adventure? Is the now colorful world, the same world where she used to live? Or is there more to it here than she initially thought?

Maybe once she gets the three stones, she will finally understand more about herself. Her past, future, and her connection with the old man. Maybe it ran deeper than she first thought?




  • 4 different wigs, and one secret hair accessory!
  • 5 different dungeons!
  • 10 hidden cats to find for an optional sidequest!
  • 2 to 5 hours of playtime!
  • 5 different endings!
  • 2 hidden hearts, bringing the maximum health bar to 4!
  • 1 secret item, allowing you to see secrets and hidden passages!
  • 1 epic adventure to remember!

short_description: A humorous adventure of epic proportions, spanning 1 fully open map, 2 worlds, and (more than) 3 colors! The Old Man gives Pixi a quest: find the 3 stones and use them to restore the colors! During her adventure, she will have to cross dungeons, another world, and maybe even face... herself.
